githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.1 improves unread-state handling, message rendering, member role colors, and keyboard navigation. It also updates the project’s licensing and lint enforcement.

## Fixes
- Fixed guild member role color hydration.
- Fixed unread-state lifecycle behavior and timeline placement.
- Fixed quadratic unread reconciliation.
- Fixed rendering of Discord angle-bracket links.

## Keyboard shortcuts
- Added an Up Arrow shortcut for editing the latest message.
- Added numbered server navigation shortcuts.

## Project maintenance
- Licensed SakuraCord under GPL-3.0.
- Balanced the SwiftLint policy.
- Eliminated the SwiftLint baseline and added commit-time checks.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.0...v0.1.1](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1)
